description: This file defines a CMake function 'dfs_callback' that performs a depth-first traversal of a data structure, emitting events for different node types such as lists and maps, and handling references to visited and unvisited nodes. It is used for parsing complex nested data structures within CMake scripts.

methods.name: dfs_callback
methods.description: Main function that initiates the depth-first traversal of a data structure, setting up the callback environment and starting the recursive inner function.

methods.name: dfs_callback_inner
methods.description: Recursive inner function that processes each node, determines if it is a map or list, and emits corresponding events, handling visited references to avoid cycles.
